notes.title: Reek N' Havok - Update 1
notes.content:
UPDATE 1 FULL CHANGELIST -

Two new levels, visual improvements, bug fixes and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39754729/254f3ac8ef5a9b94ac440a21105780628a714078.png

NEW STUFF


 New level - Black Pines
 New Level - Sodden Isle
 Lesson guides in tutorial levels
 Waypointer system - A disembodied goblin hand will now beckon you towards your objectives
 Respawn checkpoints in tutorials
 Added new NPC notification to show when they’re searching for a player


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39754729/972963666b02f10aa7f709392564658df0e78df9.png

CHANGES


 Score removed from the game, instead we’ll be using time to grade your skill
 New model and sounds for the Sawmill
 Tutorial 1, Tutorial 2 and Windy Creek cutscene updates
 Increased interact range for lantern relighting
 Rebalanced level resource values
 Buffed and nerfed the destruction of different resources depending on the level
 Added a slight cooldown on picking up bananas (sorry, banana spammers)
 Main menu screen updates 
 Level descriptions, new entries for Sodden Isle and Black Pines
 Improved line of sight detection on NPC AI
 There is now a confirmation screen when wiping save game
 Adjusted Bomb sound effect
 Population icon updated
 Tree stump model updated
 Tree regrowth time increased
 Plague doctor has had his vaccines and is no longer susceptible to disease
 Villagers and player are now “blown” back off of bridges when they are destroyed to prevent them being stuck
 Resource cart will now only stop if the player stand in front of it, not behind or beside it
 Each level town now has a unique statue
 Resources now have upper and lower limits (999 and 0)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39754729/440511655238e954edfce7075c5a5c2a93dd7afb.png

FIXES


 Fixed an issue where day/night system was desyncing from on screen clock
 Tutorial 2 will no longer end prematurely
 Fixed an issue where “Trip Villagers” objective would appear in other levels than Tutorial 2
 Bonus objectives fixed in Tutorial 2
 Tutorial 2 “burning woods” cutscene is now skippable, and no longer breaks when using a bomb to set fire to trees
 Fixed an issue where players could not infect well after infecting wheat (and vice versa)
 Lanterns now reliably turn on/off at the beginning of night and day
 Bridges shouldn't be misaligned after being rebuilt.
 Fixed an issue where villagers were immune to the toxic slick
 Event “!” Icon will no longer show on clock if there are no events that day
 Various audio and voiceline fixes
 NPC knockout fixes:
 NPCs can now no longer recover from being knocked down
 NPCs can now no longer speak when knocked down
 Witch mission values can no longer increase above the target value, not decrease below 0
 Bananas and Toxic Slicks are now more reliable and have a smaller “trip” range
 Various AI improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39754729/9a491101ec3ca9067d58aedca1b33908033bcac4.png

Thank you for "Reeking Havok" so far, we hope you continue to do so!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39754729/d428c44743c3f616d4fffca734c325cb67540707.png
